runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 15:46 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade result passed the combined location, language, skill and response-probability gates. Upwork surfaced a worldwide WooCommerce Product Listing & Upload Specialist at 10-30 USD/hour, but it is three weeks old with 20-50 proposals, 1 hire and 4 interviews. Allegro/Mall surfaced a 100% home-office Bratislava partner-support role, but fluent Hungarian and Slovak are explicit requirements. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Foreign-language hard-gate matrix
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Maintain a structured language capability matrix and automatically distinguish optional/translation-assisted language mentions from genuinely fluent mandatory languages such as Hungarian, preventing attractive remote e-commerce roles from wasting application time.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Freelance scope-to-budget ratio
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Estimate project breadth from task verbs and deliverables, then divide fixed budget by estimated effort band. Suppress superficially attractive WooCommerce matches where a full-site build or hard development scope implies an unrealistically low effective hourly return.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER was attempted where full round-trip content could not be guaranteed.
